source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the digital literacy gap (PDF 184).

blocks.text: Technology tak rasai ke baghair log digital maharat nahi seekhte, jis se technology jaanne walon aur doosron ka faasla mazboot hota hai. Pakistan mein computer aur internet se mehroom log naukri ki darkhwast ya online sarkari khidmat jaise kaamon ki maharat seekhne ke mauqe kho dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Digital khwandagi ka faasla khud ko mazboot kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Rasai nahi to mashq nahi, to maharat nahi banti, aur maharat ke baghair baad ki rasai se bhi kam faida hota hai, to log peeche rehte hain.

items: Digital khwandagi ka faasla: rasai nahi, maharat nahi, to faasla barhta hai.
